sentences: Ek pass mein bada element right chala jaata hai, isliye array sort ho gaya.
6 aur 5 swap hue, phir 5 aur 4 swap, sab set ho gaya.
Har j pe check kiya, jo bada tha use aage bheja, bas.
Loop n-1 tak chalta hai, matlab poora array cover ho gaya.
Swap hone ke baad chhote se bada order aa gaya, so sorted.
